rationale: High feature dimensionality; susceptible to noise in redundant network counters.
Dimensionality reduction eliminates noise, improving both accuracy and speed.
Gradient boosting effectively separates non-linear decision boundaries.
Fully connected layers capture general patterns but miss sequential dynamics.
Local convolutional filters extract spatial flow representations.
Bidirectional recurrent cells capture forward-backward packet transitions.
Convolutional feature abstraction + BiLSTM recurrence + Self-Attention weighting achieves state-of-the-art detection.
